resources.string: An ancient dragon capable of incinerating entire kingdoms in a single night.
The Lord of the Seas, a terrifying Leviathan that rules underwater ecosystems with lightning attacks.
A fiery Brute Wyvern that coats its fists and horn in explosive green slime.
An alpha Bird Wyvern that commands Jaggi packs with distinctive loud howls.
A colossal Elder Dragon of gigantic length that reshapes mountains with its sheer size.
An aggressive giant boar that leads Bullfango herds and charges furiously at foes.
Mysterious companion hunters hailing from the distant Outlands.
An armored Brute Wyvern that wallows in mud to protect its body from scorching heat.
The King of the Skies, famous for swift aerial strikes and devastating fireballs.
A flame-wreathed Elder Dragon that scatters explosive blast powder around its enemies.
A rare subspecies of Nargacuga that turns invisible in moonlight and launches venomous tail spikes.
A wolf-like Fanged Wyvern that coats its body in icy armor when enraged.
An Elder Dragon covered in elegant silver scales that commands energy-draining Qurio parasites.
A rare Mizutsune variant that produces highly flammable gas bubbles filled with purple fire.
A mutated Elder Dragon that zooms through the sky like a crimson comet using dragon energy jets.
An Elder Dragon with the power to freeze all in its path, creating massive ice pillars.
A nomadic apex predator with a boundless appetite that consumes everything in its path.
The leader of the Jagras pack, known to swallow prey whole to swell its belly.
A destructive Elder Dragon known as the Extinction Dragon, feeding on other Elder Dragons.
A terrifyingly agile scavenger that uses dual claws to inflict heavy bleeding.
A legendary Blazing Black Dragon capable of commanding all elemental forces.
A fiery Brute Wyvern with a massive blade-like tail that it sharpens using its jaws.

A short-tempered Bird Wyvern with a hard shell, poisonous tail, and fiery breath.

A mysterious apex monster from the Wilds featuring long chain-like wing appendages.
